description: Explicitly refresh external registry metadata: resolve moving main once to a full commit, then capture one coherent fixed inventory/manifest snapshot using the qualified client. Pass body:{commandId,expectedSnapshot,expectedRevision}; both expected values are null only for first selection. Preserve the observed snapshotRevision returned by current discovery and the exact snapshot as the CAS witness. Native author sessions inject their existing replay-stable top-level commandId. Stale head/revision refuses rather than rebasing silently. Refresh does not change customer sources, local forks or timeline placements. Preview/variable/dependency metadata changes remain separate, and actual source-byte differences require explicit acquisition before adaptation, review and guarded adoption.

commandId.description: Create with boundedCommandId(ulid(), digest) from @cueframe/studio-contracts/commandIdentity, using ulid from the ulid package: cf1:<26-character uppercase ULID>:<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters>. Keep the whole original identity for every retry within the 14-day retry window. After expiry, reconcile the original outcome instead of assigning a new identity. The caller-provided digest is not checked against the request body.
Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.
